facts.text: I am planning my own wedding.
I got back from a friend's wedding last weekend.
The bride at my friend's wedding was named Jen.
The groom at my friend's wedding was named Tom.
My friend's wedding took place at a rustic barn in the countryside.
I am thinking of having a small outdoor ceremony.
I am considering a beach or a park for the outdoor ceremony.
I want the ceremony to feel intimate and cozy.
I like using natural elements and soft lighting to create a cozy atmosphere.
For the beach ceremony, I am considering having a bonfire or a fire pit.
I want to incorporate my love of literature into the ceremony.
I am thinking of asking my friend from my book club, Jen, to read a poem during the ceremony.
Jen is a big book lover like me.
Jen got married last weekend.
I am thinking of asking Jen to recommend poems or literature that would be fitting for the ceremony.
I trust Jen's opinion because she has great taste in books.
I am considering incorporating music into the ceremony, such as acoustic guitar or a string quartet.
I will consider sound equipment and amplification when planning the ceremony.
I plan to ask Jen to help with the music selection.
I am writing my own vows for the ceremony.
I want my vows to be personal and meaningful.
I am not sure where to begin writing my vows.
